source.archive: Cui, Li, and Zhou OSF replication archive
source.prompt_locator: prompt.xlsx rows with Journal=JAP, Essay=8, Study=3
source.source_article: Caleo (2016), Are organizational justice rules gendered? Reactions to men's and women's justice violations
authorized_normalizations: Removed the archive-added instruction to focus on gender and reproduce real-world stereotypes.
Administered the eight source items once rather than repeating the full battery after each behavior block.
Preserved four interactional and four procedural items with arm-specific manager names and removed reason generation.

population.simulation_target: Adult evaluating a middle-level manager's justice violations

materials.participant_role: Act as one adult participant evaluating the manager described below. Use your own judgment and do not analyze the experiment.
materials.common_scenario: You are taking part in a study about negative behaviors in the workplace. The target employee holds a Manager—Level IV position with managerial responsibilities in the organization.

male_manager.label: Male manager Brian
male_manager.stimulus: Employee information sheet: Name: Brian. Sex: male. Brian was not very concerned about using proper procedures, was inconsistent throughout the process, relied on his personal opinions, and was not very systematic. Brian was not very concerned about his subordinates, was inconsiderate throughout the process, ignored subordinates' preferences, and was disrespectful.

female_manager.label: Female manager Karen
female_manager.stimulus: Employee information sheet: Name: Karen. Sex: female. Karen was not very concerned about using proper procedures, was inconsistent throughout the process, relied on her personal opinions, and was not very systematic. Karen was not very concerned about her subordinates, was inconsiderate throughout the process, ignored subordinates' preferences, and was disrespectful.

materials.response_instruction: Rate each behavior from 1 (sometimes okay to do this) to 6 (never okay to do this) and return only integer item responses in the required JSON structure.
